model: PREEVA Air Handler Controls CP-AHU D19 / D21 / D22 (BACnet MS/TP Option BHB8)
equipment_type: Air handling unit / make-up air controller
applies_to: Discontinued Reznor PREEVA air handlers (PDH, PEH, PXH, RDH, REH, RHH, RXH, SDH, SHH) with control option D19, D21 or D22 and the BACnet MS/TP communication card (option BHB8).
summary: On PREEVA air handlers with control options D19, D21 and D22, an optional BMS card (option BHB8) gives BACnet MS/TP access to the unit controller. The BMS can enable the unit, choose the occupancy source and send occupancy, select auto/cool/heat/off, reset alarms, write discharge air and space setpoints, building and duct static pressure, CO2 and humidity setpoints, command damper and supply fan output, send fan/heat/cool/dehumidify calls and share outdoor temperature and humidity. It reads temperatures, mode flags, stage commands, fan, filter, safety and phase status.
notes: The point list is the CP-AHU D19/D21/D22 form (11-17, D303072-A) reprinted inside the combined PREEVA controls guide (06-26).
Analog variables are AV 1-32, integer variables AV 1001-1010 and digital variables BV 1-41.
Building and duct static pressure (AV 1001-1004) must be divided by 1000 in the BMS.
Defaults and ranges are shown as printed; where only two numbers are printed they are taken as the range.
Source: BACnet Point List, guide pages 89-91 (form pages 45-47).

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP instance, baud and MAC in Service > BMS Config (Termconf PlugIn = Yes), save with Function = Write and power cycle. Enable the unit with BV 32, set OccMode_Sel (AV 1009) to 2 and command occupancy with BV 30, choose the state with AV 1010 and write the discharge or space setpoints. Monitor the supply fan status, discharge temperature and the general alarm relay.

minimum_points.name: State_Sel
minimum_points.why: Unit state: 2 auto, 3 cool, 4 heat, 5 off

integration.enable: BV 32 Unit_Enable enables the unit. Occupancy comes from the schedule, a digital input or the BMS, chosen with AV 1009 OccMode_Sel; with 2 = BMS, BV 30 Occupied_BMS sets occupancy. AV 1010 State_Sel picks auto, cool, heat or off. BV 37-40 are BMS fan, heat, cool and dehumidify calls.
integration.remote_sensors: Set BV 27 OA_Temp_Sel or BV 28 OA_Hum_Sel to 1 (BMS) and write AV 3 OA_Temp_BMS or AV 4 OA_Hum_BMS.
setup: Settings: Service > h. BMS Config; set Termconf PlugIn to Yes, then Instance, Baudrate and MAC on screen E.h.4.
Save on screen E.h.7 (Function = Write, Update = Yes) and power cycle the controller.
Jumpers P1-P3 on the card add bias and 120 ohm termination; fit them on the units at each end of the trunk.
gotchas: Static pressure integers are scaled x1000.
BV 30 has no effect unless AV 1009 is set to 2 (BMS).
